title: I'm building a cozy isometric builder where you restore a run-down town back to its former glory
author: ttjjbb

comments.author: WHERES_MY_SWORD
comments.body: The NPC movement reminds of rollercoaster tycoon a little, I like the art style. What will the gameplay loop be? Is it like a city builder?

replies.author: ttjjbb
replies.body: Definitely inspired by rollercoaster tycoon! It's less a city builder and more cozy/incremental-ish where you restore buildings, upgrade shops, and decorate
